artifacts.scope: Opal authenticated local TLS/WSS gateway and bounded AUX JSON state proxy
Existing Owner PWA assets with local adapter and cloud fallback

requiredBeforeAnyInstallOrDeployment: Read-only Opal preflight confirms exact current Matrix/AUX identities, required Lua modules, existing services, and package rollback inputs.
DNS-01 trusted certificate is installed at the exact paths and SAN; local hostname resolution to 192.168.77.1 works with WAN disconnected.
Guest/unpaired access to direct Matrix/AUX WLED APIs is actually isolated and field-tested; the marker alone is not proof.
The read-only verify_local_pairing Edge action is deployed through its guarded release path before local enrollment is tested.
Fresh Cloudflare Worker identity and exact rollback version are captured before publishing Owner PWA assets.
Actual iOS 12 device opens the existing PWA, authenticates, controls Matrix/AUX with WAN off, and confirms physical behavior.
knownLimits: No Opal, Cloudflare, Supabase, firmware, router, or physical device changes were performed.
Host fixtures do not prove OpenWrt Nginx/Lua runtime compatibility or physical Matrix/AUX output.
WLED state readback is not proof of physical illumination; unpaired direct-WLED isolation remains unverified.
Only commands supported by the current local HBNF transport are routed locally; unsupported operations retain existing cloud behavior and are not claimed to work offline.
